values.name: stench
values.label: Stench
values.effect: This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect. This ability does not stack with a held item. Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.

values.name: drizzle
values.label: Drizzle
values.effect: The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

values.name: speed-boost
values.label: Speed Boost
values.effect: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.

values.name: battle-armor
values.label: Battle Armor
values.effect: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Shell Armor.

values.name: sturdy
values.label: Sturdy
values.effect: When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP. Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold. If this Pokémon is holding a Focus Sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed.

values.name: damp
values.label: Damp
values.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, Self-Destruct and Explosion will fail and Aftermath will not take effect.

values.name: limber
values.label: Limber
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed. If a Pokémon is paralyzed and acquires this ability, its paralysis is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

values.name: sand-veil
values.label: Sand Veil
values.effect: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

values.name: static
values.label: Static
values.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed. Pokémon that are immune to Electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an Electric Pokémon, if applicable.

values.name: volt-absorb
values.label: Volt Absorb
values.effect: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.

values.name: water-absorb
values.label: Water Absorb
values.effect: Whenever a Water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute.

values.name: oblivious
values.label: Oblivious
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to Captivate. If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared.

values.name: cloud-nine
values.label: Cloud Nine
values.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock.

values.name: compound-eyes
values.label: Compound Eyes
values.effect: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy. This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold). Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively.

values.name: insomnia
values.label: Insomnia
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Vital Spirit in battle.

values.name: color-change
values.label: Color Change
values.effect: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move. If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden. The Pokémon must directly take damage; for example, moves blocked by a Substitute will not trigger this ability, nor will moves that deal damage indirectly, such as Spikes. This ability takes effect on only the last hit of a multiple-hit attack. In Pokémon Colosseum and XD: Gale of Darkness, this ability does not take effect on Shadow-type moves.

values.name: immunity
values.label: Immunity
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be poisoned. This includes bad poison. If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

values.name: flash-fire
values.label: Flash Fire
values.effect: This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves. Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle. This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen. The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled. Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. Will-O-Wisp.

values.name: shield-dust
values.label: Shield Dust
values.effect: This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it. An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.

values.name: own-tempo
values.label: Own Tempo
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be confused. If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed.

values.name: suction-cups
values.label: Suction Cups
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by moves such as Whirlwind. Dragon Tail and Circle Throw still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the success rate while fishing is increased.

values.name: intimidate
values.label: Intimidate
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage. In a double battle, both opponents are affected. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle. This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a Substitute. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.

values.name: shadow-tag
values.label: Shadow Tag
values.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.

values.name: rough-skin
values.label: Rough Skin
values.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage. This ability functions identically to Iron Barbs.

values.name: wonder-guard
values.label: Wonder Guard
values.effect: This Pokémon is immune to damaging moves that are not super effective against it. Moves that inflict fixed damage, such as Night Shade or Seismic Toss, are considered super effective if their types are. Damage not directly dealt by moves, such as damage from weather, a status ailment, or Spikes, is not prevented. This ability cannot be copied with Role Play or traded away with Skill Swap, but it can be copied with Trace, disabled with Gastro Acid, or changed with Worry Seed. This Pokémon can still use Role Play itself to lose this ability, but not Skill Swap. If this Pokémon has a Substitute, this ability will block moves as usual and any moves not blocked will react to the Substitute as usual.

values.name: levitate
values.label: Levitate
values.effect: This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball. This ability is not disabled during Roost.

values.name: effect-spore
values.label: Effect Spore
values.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random. Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected.

values.name: synchronize
values.label: Synchronize
values.effect: Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment. This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.

values.name: clear-body
values.label: Clear Body
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle.

values.name: natural-cure
values.label: Natural Cure
values.effect: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon. If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.

values.name: lightning-rod
values.label: Lightning Rod
values.effect: All other Pokémon's single-target Electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability. If the Pokémon is a Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost.

values.name: serene-grace
values.label: Serene Grace
values.effect: This Pokémon's moves have twice their usual effect chance. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Flamethrower's chance of burning the target is doubled, but Protect's chance of success and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate are unaffected. Secret Power is unaffected.

values.name: swift-swim
values.label: Swift Swim
values.effect: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

values.name: chlorophyll
values.label: Chlorophyll
values.effect: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

values.name: illuminate
values.label: Illuminate
values.effect: Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled. This ability has no effect in battle.

values.name: trace
values.label: Trace
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability. This ability cannot copy Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.

values.name: huge-power
values.label: Huge Power
values.effect: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Pure Power.

values.name: poison-point
values.label: Poison Point
values.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

values.name: inner-focus
values.label: Inner Focus
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot flinch.

values.name: magma-armor
values.label: Magma Armor
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be frozen. If a Pokémon is frozen and acquires this ability, it will immediately thaw out; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Flame Body.

values.name: water-veil
values.label: Water Veil
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be burned. If a Pokémon is burned and acquires this ability, its burn is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

values.name: magnet-pull
values.label: Magnet Pull
values.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Steel-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate.

values.name: soundproof
values.label: Soundproof
values.effect: This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based. Heal Bell is unaffected. Uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping. This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through Baton Pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used. Howl, Roar of Time, Sonic Boom, and Yawn are not flagged as sound-based.

values.name: rain-dish
values.label: Rain Dish
values.effect: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain.

values.name: sand-stream
values.label: Sand Stream
values.effect: The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

values.name: pressure
values.label: Pressure
values.effect: Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP. This ability stacks if multiple targets have it. This ability still affects moves that fail or miss. This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

values.name: thick-fat
values.label: Thick Fat
values.effect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

values.name: early-bird
values.label: Early Bird
values.effect: This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1. If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up.

values.name: flame-body
values.label: Flame Body
values.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Magma Armor.

values.name: run-away
values.label: Run Away
values.effect: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.

values.name: keen-eye
values.label: Keen Eye
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot have its accuracy lowered. This ability does not prevent any accuracy losses other than stat modifiers, such as the accuracy cut from fog; nor does it prevent other Pokémon's evasion from making this Pokémon's moves less accurate. This Pokémon can still be passed negative accuracy modifiers through Heart Swap. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.

values.name: hyper-cutter
values.label: Hyper Cutter
values.effect: This Pokémon's Attack cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any Attack losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Attack cut from a burn. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Attack modifiers through Heart Swap or Power Swap.

values.name: pickup
values.label: Pickup
values.effect: At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one. After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one. The Air Balloon and Eject Button cannot be picked up. The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

values.name: truant
values.label: Truant
values.effect: Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around"). Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do. Most such moves, for example Bide or Rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around. Attacks with a recharge turn, such as Hyper Beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as Fly, do not end up being used. Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as Outrage, Uproar, or any move forced by Encore, keep going as usual. If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending. If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or Gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn. If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did. This ability cannot be changed with Worry Seed, but it can be disabled with Gastro Acid, changed with Role Play, or traded away with Skill Swap.

values.name: hustle
values.label: Hustle
values.effect: This Pokémon's physical moves do 1.5× as much regular damage, but have 0.8× their usual accuracy. Special moves are unaffected. Moves that do set damage, such as Seismic Toss, have their accuracy affected, but not their damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

values.name: cute-charm
values.label: Cute Charm
values.effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.

values.name: plus
values.label: Plus
values.effect: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.

values.name: minus
values.label: Minus
values.effect: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.

values.name: forecast
values.label: Forecast
values.effect: During rain, strong sunlight, or hail, this Pokémon's type changes to Water, Fire, or Ice, respectively, and its form changes to match. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Castform. If the weather ends or becomes anything that does not trigger this ability, or a Pokémon with Air Lock or Cloud Nine enters battle, this Pokémon's type and form revert to their default. If this ability is lost or disabled, this Pokémon cannot change its current type and form until it regains its ability.

values.name: sticky-hold
values.label: Sticky Hold
values.effect: This Pokémon's hold item cannot be removed by other Pokémon. Damaging moves that would remove this Pokémon's item can still inflict damage against this Pokémon, e.g. Knock Off or Pluck. This Pokémon can still use moves that involve the loss of its own item, e.g. Fling or Trick. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the encounter rate while fishing is increased.

values.name: shed-skin
values.label: Shed Skin
values.effect: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.

values.name: guts
values.label: Guts
values.effect: Whenever this Pokémon is asleep, burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, it has 1.5× its Attack. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Attack cut from a burn. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

values.name: marvel-scale
values.label: Marvel Scale
values.effect: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Defense. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

values.name: liquid-ooze
values.label: Liquid Ooze
values.effect: Whenever a Pokémon would heal after hitting this Pokémon with a leeching move like Absorb, it instead loses as many HP as it would usually gain. Dream Eater is unaffected.

values.name: overgrow
values.label: Overgrow
values.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Grass-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

values.name: blaze
values.label: Blaze
values.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Fire-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

values.name: torrent
values.label: Torrent
values.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Water-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

values.name: swarm
values.label: Swarm
values.effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.

values.name: rock-head
values.label: Rock Head
values.effect: This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves. Struggle's recoil is unaffected. This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with Jump Kick or High Jump Kick.

values.name: drought
values.label: Drought
values.effect: The weather changes to strong sunlight when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

values.name: arena-trap
values.label: Arena Trap
values.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon in the air, e.g. due to Levitate or Magnet Rise, are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

values.name: vital-spirit
values.label: Vital Spirit
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Insomnia in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

values.name: white-smoke
values.label: White Smoke
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis; nor self-inflicted stat drops, such as the Special Attack drop from Overheat; nor opponent-triggered stat boosts, such as the Attack boost from Swagger. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to Clear Body in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.

values.name: pure-power
values.label: Pure Power
values.effect: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Huge Power.

values.name: shell-armor
values.label: Shell Armor
values.effect: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Battle Armor.

values.name: air-lock
values.label: Air Lock
values.effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Cloud Nine.

values.name: tangled-feet
values.label: Tangled Feet
values.effect: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.

values.name: motor-drive
values.label: Motor Drive
values.effect: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.

values.name: rivalry
values.label: Rivalry
values.effect: This Pokémon inflicts 1.25× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the same gender and 0.75× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the opposite gender. If either Pokémon is genderless, damage is unaffected.

values.name: steadfast
values.label: Steadfast
values.effect: Whenever this Pokémon flinches, its Speed rises one stage.

values.name: snow-cloak
values.label: Snow Cloak
values.effect: During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.

values.name: gluttony
values.label: Gluttony
values.effect: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.

values.name: anger-point
values.label: Anger Point
values.effect: Whenever this Pokémon receives a critical hit, its Attack rises to the maximum of 6 stages. This ability will still take effect if the critical hit is received by a Substitute.

values.name: unburden
values.label: Unburden
values.effect: When this Pokémon uses or loses its held item, its Speed is doubled. If it gains another item or leaves battle, this bonus is lost. This includes when the Pokémon drops its item because of Knock Off. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. There is no notification when this ability takes effect.

values.name: heatproof
values.label: Heatproof
values.effect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire-type moves and burns.

values.name: simple
values.label: Simple
values.effect: Each stage of this Pokémon's stat modifiers acts as two stages. These doubled stages are still limited to a minimum of -6 and a maximum of 6. This Pokémon can still accumulate less than -3 or more than 3 stages of stat modifiers, even though the extra ones have no effect after doubling.

values.name: dry-skin
values.label: Dry Skin
values.effect: This Pokémon takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn during strong sunlight, but it heals for 1/8 of its HP each turn during rain. This Pokémon takes 1.25× as much damage from Fire-type moves, but whenever a Water move hits it, it heals for 1/4 its maximum HP instead.

values.name: download
values.label: Download
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, its Attack or Special Attack, whichever corresponds to its opponents' weaker total defensive stat, rises one stage. In the event of a tie, Special Attack is raised. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle.

values.name: iron-fist
values.label: Iron Fist
values.effect: Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon. Sucker Punch is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".

values.name: poison-heal
values.label: Poison Heal
values.effect: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it will heal for 1/8 of its maximum HP after each turn rather than taking damage. This includes bad poison.

values.name: adaptability
values.label: Adaptability
values.effect: This Pokémon inflicts twice as much damage with moves whose types match its own, rather than the usual same-type attack bonus of 1.5×.

values.name: skill-link
values.label: Skill Link
values.effect: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as Icicle Spear. It also bypasses the accuracy checks on Triple Kick's second and third hits.

values.name: hydration
values.label: Hydration
values.effect: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

values.name: solar-power
values.label: Solar Power
values.effect: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.

values.name: quick-feet
values.label: Quick Feet
values.effect: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.

values.name: normalize
values.label: Normalize
values.effect: This Pokémon's moves all act as if they were Normal-type. Moves that inflict typeless damage do so as usual. Moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, are affected. They otherwise work as usual, however; Weather Ball, for example, is always forced to be Normal, but it still has doubled power and looks different during weather. As Thunder Wave is prevented by immunities, unlike most non-damaging moves, it does not affect Ghost-type Pokémon under the effect of this ability.

values.name: sniper
values.label: Sniper
values.effect: This Pokémon inflicts triple damage with critical hits, rather than the usual double damage.

values.name: magic-guard
values.label: Magic Guard
values.effect: This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move. For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or Spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a Life Orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it. Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, Leech Seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon. This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with Liquid Ooze. If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.

values.name: no-guard
values.label: No Guard
values.effect: Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss. One-hit KO moves are unaffected. Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like Dig or Fly. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

values.name: stall
values.label: Stall
values.effect: This Pokémon moves last within its priority bracket. Multiple Pokémon with this ability move in order of Speed amongst themselves. The Full Incense and Lagging Tail take precedence over this ability; that is, Pokémon with these items move after Pokémon with this ability. Pokémon with both this ability and one of these items are delayed as much as if they had only the item. This ability works as usual during Trick Room: Pokémon with this ability will move in reverse order of Speed after Pokémon without it.

values.name: technician
values.label: Technician
values.effect: This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less. This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less. Helping Hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is Defense Curl's power boost for Rollout.

values.name: leaf-guard
values.label: Leaf Guard
values.effect: This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight. This ability does not heal prior status ailments. Rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect. Yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.

values.name: klutz
values.label: Klutz
values.effect: In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative. This Pokémon also cannot use Fling. The Speed cut from the Iron Ball and the effort items (the Macho Brace, Power Weight, Power Bracer, Power Belt, Power Lens, Power Band, and Power Anklet) is unaffected. Items that do not directly affect the battle, such as the Exp. Share, the Amulet Coin, or the Soothe Bell, work as usual. All held items work as usual out of battle. Other moves that use the held item, such as Natural Gift and Switcheroo, work as usual.

values.name: mold-breaker
values.label: Mold Breaker
values.effect: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Teravolt and Turboblaze.

values.name: super-luck
values.label: Super Luck
values.effect: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.

values.name: aftermath
values.label: Aftermath
values.effect: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.

values.name: anticipation
values.label: Anticipation
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified. The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move. Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as Future Sight, and moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, count as their listed types. Counter, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.

values.name: forewarn
values.label: Forewarn
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers. values.name: unaware
values.label: Unaware
values.effect: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation. Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed. values.name: tinted-lens
values.label: Tinted Lens
values.effect: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.

values.name: filter
values.label: Filter
values.effect: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Solid Rock.

values.name: slow-start
values.label: Slow Start
values.effect: This Pokémon's Attack and Speed are halved for five turns upon entering battle. This ability also takes effect when acquired during battle. values.name: scrappy
values.label: Scrappy
values.effect: This Pokémon ignores Ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.

values.name: storm-drain
values.label: Storm Drain

If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability.

values.name: ice-body
values.label: Ice Body
values.effect: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during hail, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.

values.name: solid-rock
values.label: Solid Rock
values.effect: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Filter.

values.name: snow-warning
values.label: Snow Warning
values.effect: The weather changes to hail when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Sand Stream are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

values.name: honey-gather
values.label: Honey Gather
values.effect: This Pokémon has a chance of picking up Honey after each battle. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

values.name: frisk
values.label: Frisk
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers. In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.

values.name: reckless
values.label: Reckless
values.effect: This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power. Struggle is unaffected. The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: Jump Kick and High Jump Kick.

values.name: multitype

Covet, Thief, and Knock Off still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Unlike with Sticky Hold, this Pokémon cannot use Fling, Switcheroo, or Trick to lose its item itself, nor gain an item through Switcheroo or Trick if it does not have one. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Arceus. This Pokémon cannot use Skill Swap or Role Play to lose its ability itself. Mold Breaker cannot ignore this ability. If the Transforming Pokémon is holding a Plate, this ability will then activate and change the Pokémon into the corresponding form.

values.name: flower-gift
values.label: Flower Gift

values.name: bad-dreams
values.label: Bad Dreams
values.effect: Opposing Pokémon take 1/8 of their maximum HP in damage after each turn while they are asleep.

values.name: pickpocket
values.label: Pickpocket

If this Pokémon is wild, it cannot steal from a trained Pokémon.

values.name: sheer-force
values.label: Sheer Force

Moves that lower the user's stats are unaffected.

values.name: contrary
values.label: Contrary
values.effect: Whenever this Pokémon's stats would be raised, they are instead lowered by the same amount, and vice versa.

values.name: unnerve

values.name: defiant
values.label: Defiant

values.name: defeatist

values.name: protean

values.effect: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.

values.label: Bulletproof
values.effect: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.

values.name: competitive
values.label: Competitive
values.effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

values.name: schooling
values.label: Schooling
values.effect: If this Pokémon is a Wishiwashi and level 20 or above, then when it enters battle and at the start of each turn, it becomes Schooling Form if its HP is 25% or higher and Solo Form otherwise. This ability cannot be replaced, copied, or nullified.

values.name: disguise
values.label: Disguise
values.effect: If this Pokémon is in its Disguised Form and takes damage from a move, it switches to its Busted Form and the damage is prevented. Other effects are not prevented. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Mimikyu.

values.name: battle-bond
values.label: Battle Bond
values.effect: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent. Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Greninja.

values.name: power-construct
values.label: Power Construct
values.effect: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Zygarde.

values.name: corrosion
values.label: Corrosion
values.effect: This Pokémon's moves and item ignore the usual immunity of Poison and Steel Pokémon when attempting to inflict poison.

values.name: comatose
values.label: Comatose
values.effect: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep. It cannot be given another status ailment; it's unaffected by Yawn; it can use Sleep Talk; and so on.

values.name: queenly-majesty
values.label: Queenly Majesty
values.effect: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.

values.name: innards-out
values.label: Innards Out
values.effect: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.

values.name: dancer
values.label: Dancer
values.effect: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.

values.name: battery
values.label: Battery
values.effect: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.

values.name: fluffy
values.label: Fluffy
values.effect: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.

values.name: dazzling
values.label: Dazzling
values.effect: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.

values.name: soul-heart
values.label: Soul-Heart
values.effect: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.

values.name: tangling-hair
values.label: Tangling Hair
values.effect: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.

values.name: receiver
values.label: Receiver
values.effect: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

values.name: power-of-alchemy
values.label: Power of Alchemy
values.effect: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

values.name: beast-boost
values.label: Beast Boost
values.effect: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.

values.name: rks-system
values.label: RKS System
values.effect: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory. This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified. This ability only takes effect for Silvally.

values.name: electric-surge
values.label: Electric Surge
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.

values.name: psychic-surge
values.label: Psychic Surge
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.

values.name: misty-surge
values.label: Misty Surge
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.

values.name: grassy-surge
values.label: Grassy Surge
values.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.

values.name: full-metal-body
values.label: Full Metal Body
values.effect: This Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or abilities. This effect only applies to normal stat modifications and not more exotic effects such as Topsy-Turvy or Power Swap. This Ability is not bypassed by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze.

values.name: shadow-shield
values.label: Shadow Shield
values.effect: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage (not fixed damage!) from moves is halved. This ability cannot be nullified.

values.name: prism-armor
values.label: Prism Armor
values.effect: Super-effective damage this Pokémon takes is reduced to 0.75×. This Ability is not bypassed by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze.

values.name: neuroforce
values.label: Neuroforce
values.effect: Increases super-effective damage dealt to 1.25×.

values.name: intrepid-sword
values.label: Intrepid Sword
values.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

values.name: dauntless-shield
values.label: Dauntless Shield
values.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

values.name: libero
values.label: Libero
values.effect: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

values.name: ball-fetch
values.label: Ball Fetch
values.effect: At any time after the first Poké Ball is thrown and fails to catch a Pokémon, at the end of a turn, if a Pokémon with Ball Fetch is on the field and not holding another item, it will pick up the same type of ball as the first one thrown.

values.name: cotton-down
values.label: Cotton Down
values.effect: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stats of all Pokémon except itself.

values.name: propeller-tail
values.label: Propeller Tail
values.effect: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

values.name: mirror-armor
values.label: Mirror Armor
values.effect: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

values.name: gulp-missile
values.label: Gulp Missile
values.effect: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

values.name: stalwart
values.label: Stalwart
values.effect: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

values.name: steam-engine
values.label: Steam Engine
values.effect: Raises the user's Speed by three stages when it is hit by a Fire- or Water-type attack. The attack still deals damage.

values.name: punk-rock
values.label: Punk Rock
values.effect: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

values.name: sand-spit
values.label: Sand Spit
values.effect: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by an attack.

values.name: ice-scales
values.label: Ice Scales
values.effect: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

values.name: ripen
values.label: Ripen
values.effect: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

values.name: ice-face
values.label: Ice Face
values.effect: When an Eiscue that's in its Ice Face form is hit by a physical move, it takes no damage and changes into its Noice Face form. If a hailstorm or snowstorm begins while Eiscue is in its Noice Face form, or if it is sent out in its Noice Face form during hail, it will immediately revert to its Ice Face form.

values.name: power-spot
values.label: Power Spot
values.effect: "The power of moves used by the allies of the Pokémon with Power Spot is increased by 30%."

values.name: mimicry
values.label: Mimicry
values.effect: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

values.name: screen-cleaner
values.label: Screen Cleaner
values.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

values.name: steely-spirit
values.label: Steely Spirit
values.effect: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.

values.name: perish-body
values.label: Perish Body
values.effect: When the Pokémon with Perish Body is hit with a contact move, both the attacker and the Pokémon with Perish Body will faint in three turns.

values.name: wandering-spirit
values.label: Wandering Spirit
values.effect: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

values.name: gorilla-tactics
values.label: Gorilla Tactics
values.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

values.name: neutralizing-gas
values.label: Neutralizing Gas
values.effect: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

values.name: pastel-veil
values.label: Pastel Veil
values.effect: Prevents the Pokémon and its teammates from being poisoned. It also cures teammates of poisoning when it enters the battlefield.

values.name: hunger-switch
values.label: Hunger Switch
values.effect: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

values.name: quick-draw
values.label: Quick Draw
values.effect: If a Pokémon with this Ability selects a damaging move, it has a 30% chance of going first in its priority bracket.

values.name: unseen-fist
values.label: Unseen Fist
values.effect: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

values.name: curious-medicine
values.label: Curious Medicine
values.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

values.name: transistor
values.label: Transistor
values.effect: Increases the power of Electric-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

values.name: dragons-maw
values.label: Dragon’s Maw
values.effect: Increases the power of Dragon-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

values.name: chilling-neigh
values.label: Chilling Neigh
values.effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

values.name: grim-neigh
values.label: Grim Neigh
values.effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

values.name: as-one-glastrier
values.label: As One
values.effect: This Pokémon has the combined effects of Unnerve and Chilling Neigh. Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry. When this Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

values.name: as-one-spectrier
values.label: As One
values.effect: This Pokémon has the combined effects of Unnerve and Grim Neigh. Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry. When this Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

values.name: lingering-aroma
values.label: Lingering Aroma
values.effect: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Lingering Aroma.

values.name: seed-sower
values.label: Seed Sower
values.effect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

values.name: thermal-exchange
values.label: Thermal Exchange
values.effect: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

values.name: anger-shell
values.label: Anger Shell
values.effect: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

values.name: purifying-salt
values.label: Purifying Salt
values.effect: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

values.name: well-baked-body
values.label: Well-Baked Body
values.effect: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

values.name: wind-rider
values.label: Wind Rider
values.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

values.name: guard-dog
values.label: Guard Dog
values.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

values.name: rocky-payload
values.label: Rocky Payload
values.effect: Increases the power of Rock-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

values.name: wind-power
values.label: Wind Power
values.effect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

values.name: zero-to-hero
values.label: Zero to Hero
values.effect: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

values.name: commander
values.label: Commander
values.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

values.name: electromorphosis
values.label: Electromorphosis
values.effect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

values.name: protosynthesis
values.label: Protosynthesis
values.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

values.name: quark-drive
values.label: Quark Drive
values.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

values.name: good-as-gold
values.label: Good as Gold
values.effect: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.

values.name: vessel-of-ruin
values.label: Vessel of Ruin
values.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

values.name: sword-of-ruin
values.label: Sword of Ruin
values.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

values.name: tablets-of-ruin
values.label: Tablets of Ruin
values.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

values.name: beads-of-ruin
values.label: Beads of Ruin
values.effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

values.name: orichalcum-pulse
values.label: Orichalcum Pulse
values.effect: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

values.name: hadron-engine
values.label: Hadron Engine
values.effect: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

values.name: opportunist
values.label: Opportunist
values.effect: If an opponent’s stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

values.name: cud-chew
values.label: Cud Chew
values.effect: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

values.name: sharpness
values.label: Sharpness
values.effect: Increases the power of all 'slicing' moves by 50%.

values.name: supreme-overlord
values.label: Supreme Overlord
values.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

values.name: costar
values.label: Costar
values.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally’s stat changes.

values.name: toxic-debris
values.label: Toxic Debris
values.effect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

values.name: armor-tail
values.label: Armor Tail
values.effect: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

values.name: earth-eater
values.label: Earth Eater
values.effect: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

values.name: mycelium-might
values.label: Mycelium Might
values.effect: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

values.name: minds-eye
values.label: Mind’s Eye
values.effect: Mind's Eye enables the Pokémon with this Ability to hit Ghost-type Pokémon with damage-dealing Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It also prevents other Pokémon from lowering the Pokémon's accuracy and ignores changes to the opponents' evasion.

values.name: supersweet-syrup
values.label: Supersweet Syrup
values.effect: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.

values.name: hospitality
values.label: Hospitality
values.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.

values.name: toxic-chain
values.label: Toxic Chain
values.effect: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.

values.name: embody-aspect
values.label: Embody Aspect
values.effect: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon

values.name: tera-shift
values.label: Tera Shift
values.effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

values.name: tera-shell
values.label: Tera Shell
values.effect: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

values.name: teraform-zero
values.label: Teraform Zero
values.effect: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

values.name: poison-puppeteer
values.label: Poison Puppeteer
values.effect: When a Pokémon is poisoned by any of Pecharunt's moves, it will also become confused.

values.name: piercing-drill
values.label: Piercing Drill
values.effect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

values.name: dragonize
values.label: Dragonize
values.effect: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

values.name: mega-sol
values.label: Mega Sol
values.effect: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

values.name: spicy-spray
values.label: Spicy Spray
values.effect: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

values.name: eelevate
values.label: Eelevate
values.effect: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

values.name: fire-mane
values.label: Fire Mane
values.effect: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

values.name: aura-guard
values.label: Aura Guard
values.effect: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.
